approval.cohort: 3316 retained records; four suspect 1980 records quarantined. Fixed reference year 2026; eleven electric scooter engine capacities corrected from missing to zero using motor-power evidence. Historical prices unchanged.
approval.modeling_approach: Separate Car, Bike and Scooter models; source labels are used only for split balancing and reporting.
approval.suspension_reason: Market audit found unverified, substantially underpriced car labels and conflicting bike sources. Use separately admitted research data; do not retrain this cohort.

split.group_key: vehicle type + normalized brand + normalized model + manufacture year + odometer rounded to nearest 1000 km; excludes price and source
split.notes: Approximately 60/20/20 train/validation/test; StratifiedGroupKFold balances source representation. No temporal holdout is possible without listing dates. Grouping is a conservative heuristic, not proof of vehicle identity.

selection.tuning: Three grouped folds inside training only, optimizing MAE; retain the initial winning configuration if the tuned configuration has worse validation MAE
selection.final_fit: Refit selected configuration on train + validation, evaluate once on untouched test, export exactly that fitted estimator; never refit on test
